question: A and B together can finish a job in 40 days. A can do the same job on her own in 60 days. How long will B take to do the three-fourth of the same work all alone?
solution:

A and B together finishes work = 40 days

A alone does same work = 60 days 

**FORMULA USED:**

Efficiency = Total work/ No. of days
